title: ePaperCraft SHIRYU
description:
DESIGN IN DIGITAL. BUILD IN PAPER. MAKE IT YOURS.Draw it. Shape it. Unfold it. Print it. Build it. SHIRYU takes your idea from an on-screen 3D design to a paper model you can hold—all in one Windows app.

Related Japanese patent publication: JP 2006-309363.

Draw an outline, turn it into a 3D part, and connect it to the model.

Choose an included model, then edit its shape, colors, and patterns on screen.

Choose a photo and apply it directly to the 3D model.

FROM 3D DESIGN TO PRINTABLE PATTERN—ALL IN SHIRYUBuild the 3D form on screen, then edit its shape, color, and patterns. SHIRYU unfolds it into paper parts, lets you arrange the printable layout, and sends it to your printer. Cut, fold, and glue the parts to make a real object you can hold.

START TODAY. GO AS FAR AS YOUR IDEAS.• 70+ included models—choose one, print it, and start building

• Create and edit original 3D paper-craft models

• Adjust shapes, colors, patterns, and part placement on screen

• Convert 3D models into printable unfolded patterns

• Edit the shape and arrangement of paper parts before printing

• English and Japanese interfaces

• Visual tutorials and two quick-reference control sheets

• Create animated GIFs automatically and share your work

• Use your original creations commercially

• Use SHIRYU for hobbies, education, workshops, and creative projects

70+ MODELS INCLUDED. PRINT FIRST, CREATE NEXT.

Choose an included model and start paper crafting the same day. The guide below shows the shortest route from launching SHIRYU to selecting a model, generating the unfolded pattern, and printing it. No wandering through menus.

BUILD A WHITE CAT FROM SCRATCH—EVERY STEP CONNECTED

Follow one complete example: draw the outline, turn it into 3D, connect the parts, add color, unfold the model, print it, and assemble it. Every step shows how your design moves toward the finished paper model.

A GRADE-SCHOOL STUDENT COMPLETED AN ORIGINAL MODEL

A grade-school student drew the outline, turned it into a 3D model, printed it, and assembled the final paper craft. SHIRYU is easy to start and deep enough to keep creating.

MORE THAN 25 YEARS OF PAPER-CRAFT DEVELOPMENTSHIRYU began in 1999 as software bundled with a commercially published book. Books, technical presentations, and years of real-world creation shaped it into the Windows 10/11 Steam edition released in 2026.

• Jury Selection, 10th Japan Media Arts Festival

• Presented at NICOGRAPH 2012

• Featured in technical publications and commercially published books

CREATE WITHOUT GETTING LOST

Part editing, connections, coloring, view controls, saving, unfolded-pattern preview, and printing—two visual reference sheets put the main controls in front of you while you work.

PRINT IT. CUT IT. FOLD IT. GLUE IT.

All you need is paper, a printer, scissors (or a craft knife), and glue. The six-step visual guide takes the printed pattern all the way to a finished paper model.

BEFORE YOU BUILDResults vary with printer settings, paper thickness, cutting, folding, and gluing. SHIRYU is made for hobbies, education, and creative work. Do not use it for designs where dimensional accuracy or structural strength affects safety.

No generative AI was used to create the included models or program code.

FREE BONUS FOR OWNERS: SHIRYU MODEL PHOTO STUDIOIncluded at no additional charge for SHIRYU owners.

Load the included models or import original models made in SHIRYU. Change the background, move, rotate, and resize models, save layouts, and export PNG images. Images you create may be used freely, including commercially.
description_short: Design in 3D, unfold to a printable pattern, and build it in paper. SHIRYU takes your idea from screen to finished paper model—with 70+ included models, English/Japanese UI, and the free Photo Studio bonus for owners.
